eld.notes: ESL endorsement codes 488 (K-8), 489 (6-12), 490 (PreK-12). Praxis 5362 required (Professional Assessments Policy 5.105). Two pathways: traditional EPP-approved program, or TDOE's no-cost Additional Endorsement Program for already-licensed teachers (asynchronous coursework + Praxis), authorized under Educator Licensure Policy 5.502 (revised July 2021). Practicum coded null because the public TDOE pages don't enumerate clinical/practicum hours separately — set by EPPs against Specialty Area Standards Policy 5.505. 2024 update: TDOE moved EL assessment from WIDA/ACCESS to ELPA21 effective July 1, 2024 (first ELPA21 Summative Feb 5, 2025) and adopted ELPA21 ELD Standards in place of WIDA 2020. EL share rose from 4.6% (2019 baseline) to ~9% (2024 TDOE figure, 93,433 students). Held at in-progress: the SEA professional teaching standards source (Educator Licensure Policy 5.502 / Specialty Area Standards Policy 5.505 / TEAM rubric) was not retrieved this round — Teacher Code of Ethics (T.C.A. 49-5-1001) was retrieved and is not the standards document; professionalStandardsMentions booleans carry forward from baseline-2019 pending standards-doc verification.

sei.notes: Rule 0520-01-19-.03(8) requires annual ESL training only for teachers who provide Direct or Indirect ESL Services, not all teachers.
